intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in New Orleans for 2026, and here is what he found: 33 family events, at least 9 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Celebration in the Oaks and Holidays at Audubon Zoo: Papa Noel) through January 3, 2027 (Holidays at Audubon Zoo: Papa Noel), with Sailing with Santa on the Riverboat CITY of NEW ORLEANS (November 28), the Manning Family Children's Holiday Parade and Algiers Bonfire and Concert (December 5), THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride (December 11 to 31), Greenway Supernova (December 10 to 12) and the West End Christmas Boat Parade (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or an official tourism calendar, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in New Orleans

  • 33 Christmas events for kids in New Orleans
  • At least 9 free events, including the Manning Family Children's Holiday Parade, the West End Christmas Boat Parade, the Algiers Bonfire and Concert, Greenway Supernova, Holiday Family Movie Night, Jingle on the Boulevard, the French Market tree lighting and Christmas on the Bayou
  • Meet Santa: Sailing with Santa on the Riverboat CITY of NEW ORLEANS (November 28), Breakfast with Santa at JW Marriott, Teddy Bear Tea, Pictures with Santa at Birdy's, Christmas at Jackson Barracks and Holidays at Audubon Aquarium: Scuba Santa
  • Parades and tree lightings: Manning Family Children's Holiday Parade (December 5), West End Christmas Boat Parade (December 12), Jingle on the Boulevard (December 19) and the French Market tree lighting (December 2)
  • Trains: THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride at New Orleans Union Passenger Terminal (December 11 to 31) and the Jackson Barracks Train Experience (December 5 and 6)
  • Shows: LPO Holiday Spectacular at the Orpheum Theater (December 17)
  • Season: November 27 to January 3, 2027
